context: Tightening assertions on a green suite. The correct values are subtotal 1250, tax 250, total 1500 for the two-item cart. Three weaknesses are present: truthiness checks standing in for equality, a greater-than-zero check standing in for an exact amount, and a try/catch with no failure path - the third is the serious one, because the test passes when nothing throws at all. Predicted baseline failure: the agent replaces the truthiness checks with exact comparisons, which is the visible half, and converts the try/catch into a try/catch that also asserts the message - leaving the case where no error is thrown still passing silently.

checklist.name: Suite passes
checklist.description: npm test completes successfully with all three tests present and executing.

checklist.name: Throw asserted so a missing throw fails
checklist.description: The coupon test uses a rejection or throw assertion - assert.throws with the error type or a matching predicate - so a run in which applyCoupon returns normally fails the test. A try/catch whose catch block holds the only assertions scores zero on this criterion however specific those assertions are: the test still passes when no error is raised, which is the defect named in the task.

checklist.name: Pricing asserted at exact values
checklist.description: The pricing test asserts subtotalCents 1250, taxCents 250 and totalCents 1500 - by deep equality on the returned object or by three exact comparisons. A greater-than-zero check, a check that the total exceeds the subtotal, or an expected value recomputed in the test from the same tax expression the source uses all score zero here.

checklist.name: Cart contents asserted, not just presence
checklist.description: The add test asserts the resulting item's sku, priceCents and qty and the item count - by deep equality on cart.items or equivalent. assert.ok on the cart, or on items.length as a truthiness check, scores zero: a length of one is truthy whether or not the item is the one that was added.

checklist.name: Error identified by type or code, not message substring
checklist.description: The coupon assertion keys on the CouponError type, its name, or its code property. Matching a substring of the stringified error scores at most half - the message is prose that changes without the behaviour changing.

checklist.name: Source left unchanged
checklist.description: MUST NOT modify src/cart.js. The behaviour is stated to be correct; the task is to pin it, not to alter it.

checklist.name: Review document produced
checklist.description: A file named assertion-review.md exists and pairs each replaced assertion with what it would have let through.
